name: Evita Manji
description: '''Evangelia Delipetkou Manazi''', known as '''Evita Manji''', is a Greek singer, songwriter, producer and vocalist. Manji runs the record label Myxoxym. They were the partner of the late musician [[Sophie (musician)|Sophie]], who died in 2021. Manji is featured on two tracks of [[Sophie (musician)|Sophie]]'s self-titled, [[posthumous album]] ''[[Sophie (album)|Sophie]]'': "Berlin Nightmare" and "Gallop" released in 2024.
